prompt.description: The text description of the scene, subject, or action to generate in the video.

last_image_url.description: A direct link to an online image or a Base64-encoded local image to be used as the last frame of the video.

reference_image_urls.description: Subject or style reference images, referred to in the prompt as Image 1, Image 2, and so on. Reference images, videos and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.

video_urls.description: Motion reference video clips of 2-15 seconds each and at most 15 seconds combined, referred to in the prompt as Video 1, Video 2, and so on. Reference images, videos and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.

audio_urls.description: Reference audio clips of 2-15 seconds each and at most 15 seconds combined, referred to in the prompt as Audio 1, Audio 2, and so on. Cannot be the only reference — pass at least one reference image or video alongside. Reference images, videos and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files.

ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. This parameter is ignored if image_url is provided. Defaults to `adaptive`, which lets the model choose the ratio and requires a reference input; text-only generation cannot be `adaptive` and defaults to `16:9` instead.

resolution.description: The resolution of the output video, where the number refers to the short side in pixels.

duration.description: The length of the output video in seconds. 5 to 10 seconds is the recommended range.

prompt_expansion_mode.description: How much effort the model spends rewriting the prompt before generation. `balanced` returns in about a second; `quality` spends up to 30 seconds on a richer prompt.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

seed.description: Varying the seed integer is a way to get different results for the same other request parameters. Using the same value for an identical request will produce similar results. If unspecified, a random number is chosen.

id.description: The ID of the generated video.

status.description: The current status of the generation task.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

error.description: Description of the error, if any.

credits_used.description: The number of tokens consumed during generation.

usd_spent.description: The total amount of money spent by the user in USD.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api.aimlapi.com/v2/video/generations' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_AIMLAPI_KEY>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"model": "minimax/h3-max", "prompt": "Describe what you want the model to generate.", "image_url": "https://example.com/input.jpg", "duration": 5}'
